clips.label: The crystal gate · six-second draft
clips.note: Black stone and gold develop into a cyan/violet crystal gateway. Clear outlines and a persistent focal crystal; fine engraving still simplifies.
clips.details: Fresh opening B, followed by 53 recurrent paintings. Krea 2 Turbo, 1536×1024, Euler at noise 0.72, three updates, CFG1, editing adapter 0.25, reference boost 0.01 and grounding 768. Each repaint uses the already-moved previous painting for both partial-noise initialization and clean-reference conditioning. Material prompts change through the passage. RIFE finishing stays outside feedback; six seconds at 24 fps. No extra refinement pass, masks or fixed-opening reference. This is a new artistic passage, not a matched settings comparison with the earlier film.
